selection: fresh seed-42 training; final weights; baseline fixed before run
interpretation: joint data and training-budget change; not a single-variable ablation

baseline_full_validation.policy: consecutive context-reset blocks; target positions 1..N-1 scored once; short tail included; no padding; EOS and cross-document transitions included
baseline_full_validation.timing_scope: forward scoring and transfers; synchronized CUDA boundaries; excludes checkpoint loading, file hashing and input validation

training_summary.timing_scope: training loop including evaluation, logging and checkpoint writes; excludes setup and initial validation; CUDA synchronized at boundaries
training_summary.memory_scope: PyTorch allocator peaks during loop; includes resident model; not total device usage; reserved cache may originate during setup

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

routing_early.scope: training hard top-k assignments across all microbatches; percentages use assignments, not unique tokens or gate weights
